modelOverview: The Tank Must Large is the flagship size of Cartier's 2021 revival of the Must de Cartier line, itself a more accessible reinterpretation of Louis Cartier's original 1917 Tank. Cased at 33.7mm x 25.5mm in steel with high-autonomy quartz movements, it pairs Roman-numeral dials and blued-steel sword hands with interchangeable leather straps or a steel bracelet, and has since been offered in silver, green and other dial colours alongside a photovoltaic SolarBeat variant.

WSTA0041.movement: Quartz · Cartier High Autonomy movement · silver oxide battery
WSTA0041.materials: Stainless steel case; interchangeable black grained calfskin leather strap with steel ardillon buckle
WSTA0041.dial: Silvered dial with black Roman numerals, railway minute track and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; beaded crown set with a synthetic cabochon-cut spinel
WSTA0041.description: The WSTA0041 is the standard Large-model Tank Must from Cartier's 2021 relaunch, reviving Louis Cartier's 1917 design in a 33.7mm x 25.5mm steel case on an interchangeable leather strap. Its silvered Roman-numeral dial and blued sword hands define the modern 'Tank Must' look. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Silver: Steel case on an interchangeable black calfskin leather strap with a silvered Roman-numeral dial and blued-steel sword hands — the standard Large Tank Must silver-dial configuration.

WSTA0052.materials: Stainless steel case and bracelet; interchangeable steel bracelet with double-fold clasp

WSTA0052.description: The WSTA0052 is the steel-bracelet configuration of the Large Tank Must, sharing the same 33.7mm x 25.5mm case and silvered Roman-numeral dial as the leather-strap version but fitted with Cartier's interchangeable steel bracelet. The 'blue' on the crown's cabochon and the blued-steel hands are the model's signature colour accents rather than a blue dial. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Blue: References the model's blued-steel hands and blue cabochon-set crown rather than a blue dial: this WSTA0052 configuration pairs the silvered, Roman-numeral dial with Cartier's interchangeable steel bracelet.

WSTA0057.description: The WSTA0057 belongs to the green-dial family introduced for the Large Tank Must in 2023, sharing the same 33.7mm x 25.5mm steel case, quartz movement and green lacquered dial as sibling reference WSTA0056. Case, movement and dial specifications are verified against the closely documented WSTA0056; every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.
